approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Design a cheerful community picnic flyer, polished flat illustration and beautifully legible typography. Soft warm cream paper background, sunny butter-yellow, coral pink, leafy green and sky blue palette. Little hand-drawn illustrated wildflowers and tiny leaves form a delicate decorative border, playful and welcoming, uncluttered generous whitespace. Centered hierarchy with large friendly bold title and smaller clearly readable details. The ONLY text in this image must be these four exact strings, preserving capitalization and punctuation: 'Community Picnic', '12 June 2027', '12:00–15:00', 'Maple Park, East Gate'. No quotation marks rendered. No additional text, no logos, no watermark. Title may wrap into two lines. Keep the text and flowers arranged as a cohesive flyer, ready to be reformatted to portrait 4:5.
